decision.publication_recommendation: Proceed with a scoped draft for the retained historical PR626 checkpoint, credit adjacent work, and avoid claiming novelty for the R/R0 distinction or interval-endpoint/gzip methodology.
decision.scope: All eight emit.* source controls: five original emitter failures, two downstream independent-output rejections, one cosmetic acceptance; eighteen refreshed-hash semantic negatives and two positive controls.

limitations: Titles and bodies were searched across every supplied current open and closed/merged PR row; not every file in every pending PR was inspected.

The three closest pending package file/patch audits are reused only because their current heads are unchanged. Other related pending work is assessed from current title/body; current main exact-site search and three related merged READMEs were read.

Pagination is non-atomic; the later issue snapshot already includes PR1153 missing from the pull inventory. Its full body was inspected and is unrelated. Subsequent/private/local work remains outside the snapshot.
This audit did not execute contributors code, reproduce claimed validation, inspect all comments/reviews, or establish global novelty.

main_inspection.exact_site_result: All exact emit.* names occur in inherited PROOF-NOTE-R.md copies, not a new executable reversion suite.
